subject: Klarna taps Robinhood VP 👑, Last mile problem for stablecoins 🪙, PayPal partners with Workday 👱

stories.headline: Blue J raises $176M Series E led by JMI Equity at a valuation above $700M
stories.quote:
Blue J raised a $176 million Series E led by JMI Equity at a
valuation above $700 million to expand Workflows, an agentic product
that checks returns before filing, drafts replies to IRS notices, and
reviews partnership agreements.
stories.description: AI tax research engine and agentic tax workflow product

non_raise_figures.text: ARR grew 165% in the 15 months after its Series D
more than 6,500 organizations use its research engine

stories.headline: Anthropic expected to IPO at a valuation of at least $1.33 trillion
stories.quote:
Anthropic's expected IPO at a valuation of at least $1.33 trillion
could generate major gains for a broad investor base spanning venture
firms, large technology companies, private equity, and sovereign
wealth funds.

stories.headline: Klarna appoints Robinhood VP Chris Koegel as CFO, starting in January
stories.quote:
Klarna has appointed Chris Koegel as its new chief financial officer
starting in January. Koegel served as vice president, head of
corporate finance, and investor relations at cryptocurrency platform
Robinhood.

stories.headline: Italian court places Revolut Bank UAB's Italian operations under one year of judicial administration over AML failures
stories.quote:
An Italian court placed Revolut Bank UAB's Italian operations under
one year of judicial administration after finding serious anti-money
laundering deficiencies that allegedly allowed 24 suspected or
convicted criminals to move €41.9 million through the bank

stories.headline: PayPal partners with Workday to offer PayPal Direct Deposit through Workday's Enhanced Direct Deposit program
stories.quote:
PayPal announced a partnership with Workday that lets employees of
Workday customers set up PayPal Direct Deposit through Workday's
Enhanced Direct Deposit (EDD) program, giving eligible employees in
the US a way to receive their pay up to two days early.

stories.headline: Plaid launches Agent Detection to distinguish AI agents from human activity in financial sessions
stories.quote:
Plaid launched Agent Detection to help banks and fintechs distinguish
human activity from AI agents across login, onboarding, account
linking, and money movement, including identifying which AI provider
is behind a session.

facts.text: Plaid says the system detected 2.3x more agent sessions than competitors in live testing
facts.quote:

stories.headline: Mastercard opens innovation centre of excellence in Singapore, to house 250 specialists eventually
stories.quote:
Mastercard has opened an innovation centre of excellence in Singapore
that will eventually house 250 specialists working in areas such as
AI, digital commerce, and cybersecurity.
